Established

in 1828, Bureau Veritas is a leading global provider of

inspection, testing, and certification services. Our mission is to shape a

world of trust by ensuring accountability between companies, consumers, and

public institutions.

Operating

globally across eight major business segments, including Marine & Offshore,

Industry & Energy, Buildings & Infrastructure, Certification,

Commodities, Consumer Products, Government Services & International Trade, Bureau Veritas

has branches in over 140 countries, with more than 77,000 employees and over

400,000 clients worldwide. We continuously deliver high-quality services based

on customer satisfaction and proven results.

We

look forward to recruiting talented individuals to join us in advancing and

expanding our diverse range of services!
